plan.title: Plan Your Visit
plan.arrival_text: Bamberg is on the ICE Munich–Berlin line. It's a 15-minute walk from the main station to the old town. Parking: don't drive into the old town. The best option is P+R Bahnhof/Brennerstraße; on the approach roads, P+R Heinrichsdamm and P+R Kronacher Straße are alternatives.
plan.areas_text: Bamberg has two halves: the Bergstadt (the hill town — Domberg, Kaulberg) on the left bank of the Regnitz, and the Inselstadt (the island town) between the river's two arms. The Gärtnerstadt (the gardeners' quarter) lies to the east and north-east — Mittelstraße, Heiliggrabstraße, Siechenstraße. Everything is walkable, but the hills are real — 340 m of climbing for the full loop.
plan.card_text: The BAMBERGcard is a 3-day ticket: the guided city tour "Faszination Welterbe," entry to several museums and collections, and free travel on bus and rail in Bamberg and the surrounding Bamberger Land. The cheaper BAMBERGcärdla is the same but without the transport. Buy it online, at the Tourist-Information at Geyerswörthstraße 5, or at many hotels. Prices: BAMBERGcärdla €16, BAMBERGcard €22 (as of July 2026). Some museums close on Mondays or Wednesdays, and access during the winter months is limited even for cardholders.
plan.water_text: Bamberg's tap water is safe and excellent — refill your bottle as you walk. Restaurants, though, are under no obligation to serve free tap water (Leitungswasser); many will decline or add a charge. If in doubt, order a mineral water.
plan.hours_text: Bamberg museums are often closed on Mondays. Many churches are open during the day. Breweries have flexible hours — check their websites before visiting.
plan.hours_disclaimer: The hours listed here are not official and may change at any time. Please check the official website of each location before your visit.

passport.footnote: These are the nine classic private breweries listed by Bamberger Brauereien e.V.: Ambräusianum, Fässla, Greifenklau, Kaiserdom, Keesmann, Klosterbräu, Mahrs Bräu, Schlenkerla, Spezial. Other counts exist.
